description: This Java source file defines a handler class RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler that enforces the presence of a void reason when a voided object (such as Patient or Encounter) is saved. It implements validation logic to ensure void reasons are not null or blank for supported object types in the OpenMRS medical record system.

classes.name: RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class for ensuring that voided entities within OpenMRS contain a void reason before being saved.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Validates that when an object supporting voiding is marked as voided, it has a non-blank void reason; throws APIException otherwise.
